hints.title: Interval Consolidation
hints.text: Sort and merge all overlapping meeting intervals to determine the continuous periods when meetings are held.

hints.title: Occupied Days Count
hints.text: For each disjoint merged interval [start, end], the count of occupied days is end - start + 1.

hints.title: Subtraction from Total
hints.text: Subtract the sum of all occupied days across merged intervals from days.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Marking an array of length days takes O(days) time and memory, which fails when days = 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond the in-place sorted meetings array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort and merge intervals in linear scan instead of array-based marking.
